note: US quickturn HDI fab (Aurora, CO). Published: 2.75 mil (0.0699 mm) trace/space, laser microvias with 2 mil (0.0508 mm) annular ring (laser via diameter + 4 mil pad), stacked microvias, blind/buried vias, VIA-IN-PAD (resin-filled, copper-capped), laser direct imaging, sequential lamination, up to 40 layers, fine pitch to 0.3 mm, no minimum order. Laser drill size not published: 4 mil (0.1016 mm) assumed, industry-typical; via diameter derived as drill + 2x annular. Edge clearance and thickness not published; conservative placeholders. With via-in-pad this fab can escape 0.5 mm BGAs that channel-only routing cannot.
